baseline_axioms.formula: The cycle word contains at least one geometry leg and at least one entropy leg, and the selected geometry and entropy transition tables differ on at least one carrier state.

At least one entropy leg changes the entropy coordinate of the visited phase state.
At least one geometry leg changes the geometry coordinate of the visited phase state.
The finite trace obeys the selected transition table at every leg and its final state equals its initial state.
A single Boolean Axis-6 sign is selected for the cycle; each leg sign equals it and the selected sign indexes every applied transition table.
No count of geometry legs, entropy legs, directions, classes, phase states, or positions is constrained to four or to factors whose exact coverage totals four.

candidate_additional_axioms.formula: Every adjacent pair of legs, including the last/first pair, has different work kinds.
Every geometry leg changes the geometry coordinate and every entropy leg changes the entropy coordinate.
The visited states before final closure are pairwise distinct.
No proper nonempty prefix of the trace returns to the initial state.
At least one visited pre-closure state witnesses G(E(q)) != E(G(q)).
Replaying the same work word from the same initial state with the opposite shared Axis-6 sign does not close.
For the selected sign, both work maps are permutations of the nine-state carrier.
Flipping the work kind of any one leg while holding its position and the shared sign fixed breaks closure.
Deleting any one leg while preserving the order of all remaining legs breaks closure.
Replaying the work word in reverse order from the same initial state and shared sign does not close.
